assets.name: Maul
assets.prompt: Create the advanced Molten Core Guard version of the referenced RimWorld fire giant equipment. Keep vanilla RimWorld game art: thick dark outlines, chunky readable shapes, flat muted dark iron and warm dark copper fills, at most 2 shading tones, no fine texture, no realistic rendering. The advanced tier has reinforced overlapping plates and a few SMALL dull orange inset core vents (flat color, no bloom, no surrounding glow). Transparent alpha, no labels, no text, no background. One oversized two-handed breaching warhammer sprite, square canvas. Preserve the reference's upper-right hammer head / lower-left brown wrapped handle diagonal orientation. Upgrade with thick angular steel striking faces and one small rectangular orange core in the hammer head, reinforced copper collar. Entire object with transparent padding. Single weapon, no character.
